usage: 妹妹 is used to specifically refer to a younger sister in the family.
When talking about siblings older or younger, 妹妹 is reserved for the younger sister only.
You can use 妹妹 to introduce or talk about family members in daily conversations.
In sentences, 妹妹 typically appears as a subject or object referring to the younger sister.
It is a familiar term and can be used in both formal and informal contexts.
